name: RF31
source:
??? - robot - n/a (referred to as m)

Rafael is a mysterious robot living on his own. No one knows where he came from, who he was built by, or what his purpose is. He does take an unusual interest in exceedingly normal things like cooking, cleaning, and watching TV, though. He tries to act as organic as possible, but his forced attempts usually just emphasize how much of a machine he is.

"Whassup! ...Did I use that slang correctly?"

[From [url=http://www.duenkhy.com/]official site[/url]]
